_comment: THREE PILLARS P5: the milestone's own end-to-end proof of the FIELD-SKILL LOOP. Loads the near_tactician fixture (warrior L1 at the inn, chess_with_olesm banked (the [Tactician] driver -- earned at Olesm's chessboard), [Basic Cleaning] innate) via the title 'Continue'. PHASE A proves the overworld hotbar itself: it renders at load (slots:1, the innate [Basic Cleaning]); a NUMBER KEY on the faced dirty_table fires the exact interact stream (P1 byte-parity: skill_used{basic_cleaning,dirty_table} + accomplishment cleaned_the_inn + the same toast); and a number key facing empty floor takes the field_ambient fallback. PHASE B proves the earned-class arc: one sleep resolves TWO gained_by gates at once -- the pre-banked chess_with_olesm grants [Tactician] (the class is earned at Olesm's chessboard, user ruling) and Phase A's fresh cleaned_the_inn:1 grants [Helper] (a genuine emergent co-grant: the loop earns Helper by doing the chore) -- so the hotbar RE-RENDERS from 1 field slot to THREE ([Basic Cleaning], [Helper]'s [Basic Cooking], [Tactician]'s [Appraise Foe], in catalog order). Pressing [Appraise Foe]'s slot (3) on Erin surfaces her exact observe string as a toast and reveals the skill in the journal (used_skills). No combat anywhere -- fixture rng_state governs, --seed is cosmetic; seed 9 for convention.

steps._comment: == PHASE A: hotbar renders 1 innate slot; field dispatch (parity) + ambient fallback ==. readout_lines carries the new cost/effect summary row -- basic_cleaning is exploration-only (no `effect` key) so WIEffectText.skill_effect_lines([]) degrades it to 'Name — description', proven exactly here (structural, no OCR).

Face Erin (7,2): teleport down to (2,3) (the cell the old ground-floor route reached via 'up 3'), right5 -> (7,3), up1 blocks on Erin & faces her.
Slot 3 is [Appraise Foe] (catalog order: innate basic_cleaning, then helper's basic_cooking, then tactician's observe -- basic_cooking is field-tagged too). Press it facing Erin.

payload_contains.text: A young human, no armor, no weapon, no idea she is the strangest thing in this world. She moves like someone still deciding to be brave. The inn already leans toward her.

== PHASE C: loadout assign through the REAL journal UI -- the field bar re-renders to the chosen subset and the number key fires the REMAPPED slot. Journal opens with the cursor on flattened row 0 ([Basic Cleaning]/Innate); move down 6 rows to [Appraise Foe] (flattened order: Innate's basic_cleaning, then Warrior's L1 grants basic_swordwork/tough_body/power_strike/piercing_strikes, then Helper's basic_cooking, then Tactician's observe). EMIT ORDER on toggle: Game.sim.loadout_toggle mutates + emits loadout_changed SYNCHRONOUSLY, which field_hotbar.gd (still mounted/listening under the journal modal) re-renders and emits ui_field_hotbar_rendered from -- BEFORE journal.gd's own _toggle_cursor_skill gets to its ui_journal_loadout_rendered emit; waits below are ordered to match.
